component.name: DeltaView
component.summary: Compare and merge folders and files, Meld-style

description.p: DeltaView compares folders and files side by side and merges the differences: copy changes across, resolve three-way merges, and synchronize folders with a preview of every step.
It compares local folders, zip and tar archives and SFTP servers, shows images and JSON, YAML and CSV by their structure, and works as git difftool and mergetool.
